description: This file defines custom formatters for various CSI report related data structures in the ocudu namespace, including configuration, PMI, report data, and size. It includes external headers for configuration, data, size, UCI formatters, and the fmt library.

classes.name: fmt::formatter<ocudu::csi_report_configuration>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::csi_report_configuration, formats fields like nof_csi_rs_resources, pmi_codebook, and ri_restriction.

classes.name: fmt::formatter<ocudu::csi_report_pmi>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::csi_report_pmi, handles different PMI types and formats relevant fields.

classes.name: fmt::formatter<ocudu::csi_report_data>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::csi_report_data, formats optional fields like cri, ri, li, pmi, cqi1, cqi2.

classes.name: fmt::formatter<ocudu::csi_report_size>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::csi_report_size, formats size components like part1, part2, min, and max sizes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the respective data structure into the output context.
